The '''stabbed legionary''' is a member of a splinter faction of [[Caesar's Legion]] in the [[Mojave Wasteland]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]].

==Background==
He served as a soldier as part of the late [[Caesar (TV series)|Caesar's]] camp and a subordinate of the [[Lacerta Legate]] during the [[Legion civil war]]. He was ultimately killed by the legate in order to hide the truth of Caesar's final intentions for the Legion.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Strip]]===
After the surge of violence in the [[Legion civil war]] caused by [[the Ghoul]], the legionary observes as the Lacerta Legate retrieves the skeletal remains of [[Caesar|Edward Sallow]] and drags it into a tent to which he follows. Seeing the legate pick up Caesar's final note, he asks the legate what the contents of the note are and who will become the Legion's leader. However, having discovered that Caesar wished for the Legion to die with him, the legate tells the legionary "Long live Caesar" and fatally stabs him in the abdomen to cover up the truth. He then eats the note to fully erase all evidence and takes the opportunity to declare himself the new Caesar.

==Appearances==
The stabbed legionary appears only in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].
